name: Mizugahara Orine
source:
Heroine in "Natsuoto."

The daughter of the landlady at "Mijin-so"—the boarding house where Yuma reside at. A classmate who loves looking after others.

The more she is praised, the happier she becomes, and the more carried away she gets.
